title: The Blue Marble (2002): Land Surface, Ocean Color and Sea Ice
projection: Equirectangular global longitude–latitude map; full 2:1 world texture
orientation: North at top; longitude seam at the left and right image edges
local_modifications: None; original NASA JPEG downloaded without editing or resampling
credit_line: Earth texture: NASA GSFC / Reto Stöckli; enhancements by Robert Simmon.
credit_line_zh: 地球纹理：NASA GSFC / Reto Stöckli；增强处理：Robert Simmon。
usage_basis: NASA's media guidelines generally permit educational and informational reuse of NASA imagery and 3D texture maps, including web pages, without separate permission when used factually and without implying endorsement. NASA requests source acknowledgment. The official Blue Marble article presents these images as freely available to the public; no third-party copyright notice for this texture was found in that article.
usage_conditions: Acknowledge NASA as the source; the supplied credit line also identifies the image creators.
Do not imply NASA review, sponsorship or endorsement of this website.
The source-image reuse basis does not cover NASA logos or identifiers.
This metadata records the applicable NASA reuse guidance, rather than assigning a Creative Commons license.
notes: This is a historical satellite-data composite associated with the 2002 Blue Marble release; it is not a live satellite view or current weather map.
The selected map has land, ocean color and sea ice; it does not contain a clouds overlay or city-light layer.

The current official overview links to legacy Visible Earth catalog item 57730. At access time the legacy catalog page redirected to the Earth Observatory landing page, while the official NASA image URL remained downloadable.
JPEG dimensions and format were checked locally, and the texture was visually checked as a rectangular global geographic map.
